full_prompt_en: A square-framed reproduction of an old oil painting shows a busy rustic tavern, with the principal scene stretching horizontally across the upper half of a four-image reference. In the selected picture, a group of villagers gathers around a barrel used as a table near the left foreground. Their red, green, brown, and cream garments stand out against the smoke-darkened stone walls and timber interior. Small cups and a warm glint of drink sit on the barrel top as bearded men lean inward, talk, and watch one another. To the rear, shelves crowded with earthenware jugs and shallow dishes rise along the wall beneath a darker window or hanging frame. A seated pair occupies the central middle ground at a wooden table, their faces softly modeled among muted brown objects. Near the right, two men in blue clothing and dark broad hats stand together, one turned toward the other, making a stronger cool-colored accent amid the prevailing earth tones. At the far right edge, another figure is cropped by the frame, suggesting more tavern life beyond the view. A broad stone arch opens into a much darker recess on the far left, and the rough floor extends beneath the figures with scattered shadows. Warm light enters from the left and above, catching faces, hats, crockery, and the pale wall while the corners and doorway remain subdued. The oil surface has visible soft brushwork and aged brown varnish, so details blend gently without losing the lively gestures. The overall composition is crowded but clearly tiered, its small social groups linked by warm light, weathered surfaces, and a lively earthy rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形框景里的古典油画呈现忙碌的乡村酒馆，所选原画在四图参考的上半部横向展开。图中左前景一群村民围着当桌子使用的木桶。红、绿、棕和奶油色衣服在烟熏般暗沉的石墙与木质室内结构前显出颜色。小杯子和酒液的暖亮反光落在桶面，留胡须的男人们向内倾身，交谈或互相注视。后方，挤满陶壶和浅盘的搁架沿墙升起，上面还有更暗的窗格或悬挂框架。中景中央，一对坐着的人占据木桌旁的位置，他们的面孔在低饱和棕色物件间受到柔和塑形。靠右两位穿蓝衣、戴深色宽帽的男子站在一起，一人转向另一人，为主导的大地色调带来更强的冷色强调。最右边还有一位人物被画框截断，暗示视野之外有更多酒馆生活。最左侧宽阔石拱通往更深的暗处，粗糙地面在人物脚下伸展并带着零散阴影。暖光从左上方进入，照到面孔、帽子、陶器和浅色墙面，角落与门洞仍然幽暗。油画表面能见柔软笔触和旧棕色罩染，细节轻轻融合，却不抹去活泼姿态。整体构图拥挤但层次清楚，数个小群体被暖光、磨旧表面和活跃的大地色节奏连在一起。
style_prompt_en: The painting uses a traditional oil-on-canvas appearance with warm ocher, umber, and muted red laid around restrained blue and green accents. Small figures and objects overlap in shallow bands, yet darker arches and softened rear surfaces give the crowded scene depth. Edges are selectively precise at illuminated faces and vessels, then loosen into rubbed, varnished brown shadow. Brushwork is compact and softly blended rather than sharply graphic, while worn masonry and timber carry granular, aged texture. Light pools in irregular patches across the composition, allowing several modest focal areas instead of a single theatrical spotlight. The overall effect is earthy, social, and richly observed.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有传统布面油画外观，暖赭、棕褐与低饱和红围绕克制的蓝绿强调色铺开。小形体与物件在浅浅的空间带中重叠，较深的拱形暗部和柔化的后景表面仍为拥挤场景提供纵深。受光的局部与器皿边缘有选择地清楚，随后松散地融入经摩擦与罩染的棕色阴影。笔触紧凑而柔和融合，并非尖锐图形化，磨旧石面与木面带颗粒和年代感。光以不规则斑块散布画面，形成数个温和焦点，而非单一舞台追光。整体效果朴实、有人间交往气息且观察细密。
theme_en: Villagers gathered around a barrel table in a rustic tavern
theme_zh: 乡村酒馆中围坐木桶桌旁的村民
name: David Teniers the Younger
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
